Name: Kircerise's Portraits for Eli and Dylan
Author: Kircerise
Description:
[i][size=5]Note: This is a Content Patcher mod, not an replacer.[/size][/i]


Hei guys. I f fell so deep in love with Eli & Dylan that before I knew it, I spent two days straight without sleep drawn a custom portrait in my art style for them! Yippi!
This is for anyone who is totally head over heels for these two adorable boys. It's also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44660]Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for Eli and Dylan[/url]!

I did some test play, but honestly, I'm not even sure if it will launch properly on your end! So if you run into any bugs, please let me know in the comments or via DM! (I know pretty much zero coding, so if you happen to know how to fix it too, that would be a huge help!)


[size=5][b]Installation Guide[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Requirements: Install the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli and Dylan[/url]  first.[/*]
[*]Go to the Files page and download the mod via Manual download or Mod manager download.[/*]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI, and here you go![/*]
[/list]
